test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Authorities have stepped up efforts to control the invasion of locusts in Rajasthan and Gujarat.

options.text: Efforts to control the invasion of locusts in Rajasthan and Gujarat are being stepped up by the authorities
Efforts to control the invasion of locusts in Rajasthan and Gujarat were being stepped up by the authorities.
Efforts to control the invasion of locusts in Rajasthan and Gujarat have been stepped up by the authorities.
Efforts to control the invasion of locusts in Rajasthan and Gujarat were stepped up by the authorities.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Efforts to control the invasion of locusts in Rajasthan and Gujarat have been stepped up by the authorities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Active Voice describes a sentence where the subject performs the action stated by the verb. While in the Passive Voice subject is acted upon by the verb.
 
• The given sentence is written in the **Present perfect tense.**
 
• The structure of active voice = Subject + have/has + Verb + Object__
 
• The structure of passive Voice = __Object + has/have + been + verb (3rd form) + by + Subject__
 
• Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**

Thus the passive voice will be: *Efforts to control the invasion of locusts in Rajasthan and Gujarat have been stepped up by the authorities.*
